output.title: Still water 0.5 L PET bottling

product.name: 0.5 L still mineral water bottle
product.description: Food-grade still mineral water in a 0.5 L PET bottle with a blue screw cap and a wrap-around label. Bottle is 65 mm across and 210 mm tall.

steps.name: Fill
steps.does: Fill one 0.5 L PET bottle with still mineral water (about 3 seconds fill time).

steps.name: Cap
steps.does: Screw on the blue cap to the filled bottle.

steps.name: Label
steps.does: Apply the wrap-around label to the capped bottle.

steps.name: InspectAndReject
steps.does: Use a camera to check fill level and cap; if the bottle fails (about 1 in 20), push it off the line so only good bottles continue.

output.quality: Camera inspection finds fill-level/cap issues; about 1 in 20 bottles are rejected and diverted off the line.
constraints: Still water, food grade (hygienic contact surfaces and clean operation).
Units flow one-at-a-time on a belt (no batch handling).
After this line, good bottles are shrink-packed into six-packs (this shrink-packing is done elsewhere).
One bottle is rejected by diverting/pushing it off the line after camera inspection.
assumptions: Shift length not provided; assumed 8 hours per shift to interpret rate as 720 bottles/hour consistently.
0.5 L corresponds to nominal fill ≈ full bottle volume; exact target fill volume (e.g., 0.5 L at a specified headspace) not provided.
Wrap-around label is applied to the outside of the bottle; label type (paper/plastic) and whether heat is used are not specified.
Reject diversion is immediate after inspection, and rejected bottles do not proceed to shrink-packing elsewhere.

questions.question: After the camera check, where should rejected bottles go (e.g., chute to a bin, return to upstream, or a separate conveyor), and do you want them marked with a reject code?
questions.why: Determines the reject station/diverter and any downstream handling for scrap/rework.

questions.question: Is the camera inspection performed after capping (before labeling) or after labeling (as written in your step order, after label application)?
questions.why: Sets the station placement for inspection optics and what parts (cap vs label) must be visible.

questions.question: For the wrap-around label: is it a printed film/paper sleeve applied with heat/shrink, or a glue-applied label with no shrink?
questions.why: Determines the label applicator type and additional curing/heat steps and their cycle time.
